submission.justification: Absorber-F1 with 5 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.172% at 100 GeV, significantly outperforming Absorber-F3 (3.922% at 4 mm) and Absorber-F2 (5.045% at 4 mm). The simulation results show that 5 mm is the optimal thickness for F1, with resolution degrading at both thinner (3.712% at 2 mm) and thicker (4.699% at 10 mm) plates. This recommendation optimizes the primary goal of achieving the best possible energy resolution. All three candidate materials are confirmed to be machinable to required tolerances and compatible with the mechanical support and readout systems. However, the residual dose rate constraint (≤20 µSv/h at 1 m after one week cooldown) could not be evaluated with available tools and must be verified through separate activation calculations or measurements before final approval.
